test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of primary activity of the economic sector of India?
solution: The correct answer is __**Forestry**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • Primary Sector- sources of raw materials (agriculture and allied sector services) • They are the sources of production of raw materials for secondary and tertiary sectors, it includes: • Agriculture and forestry • Fishing and poultry farming • Animal Husbandry
